final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC8.1 (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18). The approved answer covers only the default branch of the harborlight/app repository. It says nothing about other repositories, so the answer is limited to that one. The question says 'main branch', but the source says 'default branch'. The answer uses the source's wording.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:b2d73fae-9c7e-4bc6-812b-4c01adfa5: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:70027769-06e9-43c8-a8d4-ab98fc69e: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:2e234984-eb6b-41cc-8c99-585141bfd: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:4c77b2b4-624b-48af-82e8-c16252c29: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:0cc588db-ae61-4394-b0b8-86610e256: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
